description: InvestController class manages the investment process including reward selection, user authentication, payment handling, and post-payment actions in the Goteo crowdfunding platform.

classes.name: InvestController
classes.description: Controller for managing investment workflows, including reward selection, authentication, payment processing, and completion steps in Goteo.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs payment-related messages using the configured logger.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user from session or fake-user.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates project availability, user login, reward selection, and prepares data for investment process.

methods.name: selectRewardAction
methods.description: Displays reward selection interface for a particular project.

methods.name: loginAction
methods.description: Handles user login during investment process.

methods.name: signupAction
methods.description: Handles user signup during investment process.

methods.name: selectPaymentMethodAction
methods.description: Displays available payment methods and handles user input for payment selection.

methods.name: paymentFormAction
methods.description: Handles payment form submission, creates investment records, and initiates payment gateway request.

methods.name: notifyPaymentAction
methods.description: Handles asynchronous notifications from payment gateways for off-site payments.

methods.name: completePaymentAction
methods.description: Finalizes the payment process, confirming success or failure of the transaction.

methods.name: userDataAction
methods.description: Collects additional user data after payment completion.

methods.name: shareAction
methods.description: Displays social sharing options for a successful investment.

methods.name: supportMsgAction
methods.description: Allows users to send support messages regarding investments.
